Unione Sportiva Lecce is a professional Italian football club based in Lecce, Apulia. The club plays in Serie A for the 2026-27, the top level of the Italian football pyramid. Lecce plays its home games at Stadio Via del Mare, which has a capacity of 31,533 spectators.
